version.changelog:
Initial release of mma-bridge skill.

- Enables interaction with Meteor Master AI via the mma-bridge CLI.
- Supports sending API requests to obtain current status/info from Meteor Master AI.
- Provides command usage with customizable port option.
- Includes error handling and response format documentation.
- Requires Meteor Master AI app installation and enabling of MMABridge API.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mma-bridge
Version: 1.0.0

The mma-bridge skill is a standard integration tool designed to interact with the 'Meteor Master AI' application via a CLI. It provides instructions for installing a global npm package (mma-bridge) and executing commands to fetch status information from a local API server (defaulting to port 9000). The documentation in SKILL.md points to legitimate application stores (Microsoft and Apple), and there is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions match its stated purpose (calling a local MMA Bridge CLI to query Meteor Master AI), but it recommends installing an external npm package globally (not declared in metadata) so exercise normal caution before installing that package.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description align with the runtime instructions (it calls the mma-bridge CLI to query a local Meteor Master AI service). However, the registry metadata lists no required binaries while SKILL.md explicitly expects the user to install the mma-bridge npm package (npm install mma-bridge -g). This is a mild inconsistency: the skill will only work if that external CLI is present.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits actions to running the mma CLI against a local API (default port 9000) and describes expected JSON responses. It does not instruct reading unrelated files, accessing external credentials, or exfiltrating data. It does instruct the user to install an npm package and enable MMABridge in the local Meteor Master AI app.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no formal install spec in the registry (instruction-only skill). The README recommends installing mma-bridge via 'npm install -g mma-bridge', which pulls a package from the public npm registry. Global npm installs can run arbitrary code and affect the system PATH; because the package origin/author isn't provided here, verify the package before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. Its operational needs (a local CLI and the Meteor Master AI app with MMABridge enabled) are proportionate to the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent or elevated platform privileges (always is false). It does not modify other skills or system settings in the provided instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: call a local MMA Bridge endpoint to get status info. Before installing anything, verify the npm package 'mma-bridge' on the npm registry (check publisher, download counts, source repository, and recent activity). Prefer installing the package in a controlled environment (container or VM) if you don't trust it, and avoid global (-g) installs unless you understand the package. Ensure the Meteor Master AI app's MMABridge feature is enabled on the expected port and that you only query services you control. If you want stronger assurance, inspect the package source code or install from a known, trusted release. Confidence is medium because the skill's metadata omitted the external dependency and the npm package origin is not provided here.
